scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @finance/api" "npm run dev -w @finance/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @finance/core && npm run build -w @finance/db && npm run build -w @finance/api && npm run build -w @finance/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @finance/core && npm run typecheck -w @finance/db && npm run typecheck -w @finance/api && npm run typecheck -w @finance/web
